transcription.text: If I say to Opus, I want to have three different approaches to tackle this problem, and all three
are still similar. It's just like it's stuck in a certain way of thinking. But then I use
Opus and I say I need two additional ways to tackle this problem, and I get totally different
approaches. And I merge them both into one by saying to Opus, "Hey, check the other two that
were created by Codex." And then he says, "Oh, that's a great idea. I can merge it into my ideas."
